theorem lg_target (p : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ p) (h1 : p ≤ 1) : p * (1 - p) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
  have h2 : p * (1 - p) = p - p * p := by simp [mul_sub]
  rw [h2]
  have h3 : p - p * p ≤ 1 / 4 :=
    by
      have h4 : p ≤ 1 / 2 ∨ p ≥ 1 / 2 := by linarith
      obtain h5 | h6 := h4
      · have h7 : p ≤ 1 / 2 := h5
        have h8 : 1 - p ≥ 1 / 2 := by linarith
        have h9 : p * (1 - p) ≤ (1 / 2) * (1 / 2) :=
          by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            exact h7
            exact h8
            exact le_rfl
        rw [one_div] at h9
        exact h9
      · have h7 : p ≥ 1 / 2 := h6
        have h8 : 1 - p ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
        have h9 : p * (1 - p) ≤ (1 / 2) * (1 / 2) :=
          by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            exact h7
            exact h8
            exact le_rfl
        rw [one_div] at h9
        exact h9
  exact h3
